strings.en: We have reached Mars's gravity well.
Big Bro! This planet's red!
So this is... Mars...
Oh yeah, Kamille, Hyoma, and you guys
have never been to Mars before, huh?
Can we locate the Nadesico?
Even just the space around Mars covers a huge area.
...Not right away, I'm afraid.
I was half hoping it'd just happen to show up right next to us.
That'd be way too convenient, no matter how you look at it.
But with the Nadesico, a little craziness wouldn't be surprising.
Exactly! With that captain, she could pop out saying "Sorry to keep you!"
and it wouldn't be...
Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone...
!! Hey, for real!? ...Oh, it's you. Don't scare me like that...
Eh...? Did I say something strange...?
No... it's nothing.
Now, about our course... First, we look for the Nadesico and rendezvous.
That's all we can do.
For our strength, too, joining the Nadesico before landing is best, but...
The Nadesico does have a lot of firepower.
Forgive me for interrupting...
but I have just obtained some new information.
Hey, hey, this isn't gonna be a pain, is it?
If it's the Nadesico's location, that'd make things easy...
but from how you said that, it's bad news... isn't it?
You are quite right.
...It concerns Meganoid activity on Mars.
Meganoids...!? What are they up to this time?
This time it appears to be a full-scale operation...
They're building a base about 200 km south of the Mars colony base.
Building a base... We can't leave that alone, it seems.
If a Meganoid base goes up in a place like that, the Mars colony base...
We must tell Joe and the others quickly...
We may have to put off joining the Nadesico, depending on the situation.
Yes. Mars once held the Meganoid headquarters... We can't be careless.
That black one... it was... Ilbora.
Hey, Joe! What's up? You look down.
Yeah... It's the enemy's new model.
The new model... You mean that black one from the plant planet.
Any way you slice it... that's gotta be linked to Tobikage, right, Big Bro?
Shut up! How should I know!?
Now, now, Joe, ain't no use gettin' angry.
He's right, Joe.
Well, it ain't like I don't get how ya feel.
This is hopeless.
What's wrong, Damian?
I wanted to be of some use to everyone.
I thought maybe I could pilot a machine too, so I tinkered with Kurojishi.
I don't know why, but that thing only responds to me.
I appreciate it, but then I wouldn't have anything to ride.
How about you just ride Tobikage, Joe?
Honestly, Hyoma. But... you can pilot that black robot, right?
So maybe Tobikage too...
...I don't know.
Joe...?
(Back then... it felt like Tobikage was calling me.
Ilbora boarded that black robot... and me...?)
How is construction of the base progressing?
Sir, it's going smoothly!
Good. Banjo and the humans are on Earth.
Even if they notice and come, we have time... but stay on guard.
See that the plan does not fall behind.
All hail Koros!
If we hold this place and obtain its technology...
the Meganoids can surpass humanity even further...
Yes, dear... With that technology, the Mars-Earth distance won't matter...
...Yes. I'll obtain it without fail. The technology of those ruins...
Banjo... This time not even the famous you will make it in time...
The technology called Boson Jump... we Meganoids shall make it ours.
We've jumped out.
Our position is the ruins of Utopia Colony's Central Block.
I see, a place full of memories...
Face it, Erina, you'll never come between those two, will you?
D-Don't be stupid...!?
Ha ha ha...
That was way too reckless! If it had failed, the whole crew would be dead!
Now, now, it worked out, didn't it?
But!
More importantly, why don't we all have a toast first?
This experiment is a giant step for mankind.
You can scold me later, at your leisure.
...Mmmph...
Heh...
So, what do you think, Doctor?
Well, I see the essence of Boson Jump. But one thing bothers me...
Oh?
If Boson Jump truly lets you teleport to the Moon or Mars instantly,
it violates both relativity and the constancy of the speed of light.
I'd rather not have to think about that.
Hey... you get any of that?
Dunno... not a clue.
"Rather not think about it" means you have a hypothesis, Dr. Inez?
That's all I can say for now. The rest...
Whew... So in the end, we have no choice but to study the "ruins."
Ruins...?
That's right, the ruins...
Changing jobs... my career in ruins...
Isn't that kinda off?
Sorry to interrupt, but we're nearing the polar cap ruins.
And... they've been occupied.
Wh... What!? Who would do such a thing...
Many Meganoid and Za Boom mechs are deployed around the ruins.
Captain, a message from Captain Bright.
What does it say?
"Meganoids, Gaizok, etc. deployed on Mars. Elshank followed in haste.
Rendezvous with Elshank and engage the enemy."
...Captain, the Gaizok are on Mars too...!
If the Gaizok run loose, they'll wipe out everyone on Mars!
Yurika!
No! The Nadesico will make retaking the ruins its priority.
What!? ...You'd leave the people of Mars to die!?
"Leave them to die"? That sounds so harsh.
I'm just carrying out Nergal's priority business first.
Besides, the Elshank is coming here too, right?
We can leave defending civilians to them.
You people...!!
That's awful...
Captain, your decision.
Yurika...
...The Nadesico will leave here and defend the other areas!
Heh, about time! Let's go, Tenkawa, everyone! Prep the Aestivalis!
Beginning search for the Elshank's position.
Checking the line to the Londo Bell team.
Well then, let's scram for now. Nadesico, coming about.
...What do you all think you're doing!?
...So you're ignoring Nergal's wishes?
No, no... They're simply being faithful to their duty.
The Nadesico is currently under the command of the Londo Bell team.
They're merely following orders from its commander, Captain Bright...
Ugh... Wait, if it's about clearing out the enemy, we can start right here!
Megumi, read Captain Bright's message once more, please.
Yes.
"Rendezvous with Elshank, which followed in haste, and engage."...
So that's why the Nadesico is going to look for the Elshank first!
...Sophistry, but still...
Grr... To let a chance like this slip by...
What? The Martian ruins have been occupied...?
Yes... We don't know if it was the Earthlings or someone else, but...
our observers report mech readings concentrated near the ruins.
...We can't let the Earthlings have those ruins.
Most of them seem nothing but warlike... even if some are peaceful...
Shiratori...
...Relax, Tsukiomi.
I, Tsukumo Shiratori, won't confuse duty with personal feelings.
I see. Sorry. I never thought you'd abandon justice, but...
we must destroy the evil Earth Federation Forces.
Yes...
You seem all right, then. The thing is... Earth's phase-transition ship
has reportedly appeared on Mars too.
What!? But earlier reports put it on Earth... Could it be!?
Yes. ...It's reasonable to assume a spatial jump...
Hmm... This is bad. Retaking the ruins matters, but we can't let
the Earth Federation Forces have a jump-capable battleship...
Ha ha! What are the Superior Human Corps' two sharpest fretting over?
Akiyama! How long have you been here?
Oh, I heard you went to see Shiratori looking grim.
Heh... That's just like you, Akiyama. ...It's as you heard.
We must act quickly.
Let me take on Earth's phase-transition battleship.
You...? Ah, come to think of it, I heard the Kannazuki
was issued that thing.
Right. With that, I can hold my own against Earth's other robots.
Shiratori, you don't mind?
...Very well. Akiyama, I leave the Earth ship Nadesico on Mars to you.
But... if possible, capture it rather than destroy it.
Shiratori, you really do...
No... that ship has...
That ship has...?
That ship has Minato...
I mean, the complete footage of every Gekiganger episode!
Wh... WHAT!? Is that true!?
It's true. I saw it with my own eyes when I infiltrated it.
Which means... the lost Episode 9, and Episodes 13 and 33 too...
Most likely.
...Understood. I'll try my best to capture the Nadesico.
We're counting on you, Akiyama!
Hazard Pasha, I contacted you for one reason only...
Yes, what might that be...?
When will you defeat Banjo Haran... no, the Londo Bell team?
Ah, well, you see, they're rather tough customers.
I'm working myself to the bone, striving day after day, but...
how shall I put it, er, well, yes.
Don is very angry.
My attack commander, a man named Ilbora, is utterly incompetent.
Just because he's a bit handsome, he's cheeky and pretentious!
If only he'd done his job right...
He has no intention of hearing excuses... So says Don.
Ahh, well, you see, it was I who found you, frozen since the last war,
deep inside the base, and revived you...
I'm your savior, so to speak. Oh, not that I mean to hold it over you!
We are well aware. The bitter defeat Banjo dealt us in the last war...
that we can avenge it is thanks to you, Hazard Pasha.
Oh, why, how kind!
However, that is another matter entirely.
It seems our relationship ends here.
Ends? Wh-What do you mean...?
I said our relationship with you ends here.
Human though you are, we thought you might be useful...
But Meganoids stand above humanity.
We will have nothing to do with incompetent humans.
M-M-M-Me, incompetent!?
You! I humble myself, and you get above yourself...!!
We knew from the start that you were not to be trusted...
We have already begun building a base on Mars.
We no longer need to rely on your forces.
A base... on Mars? Wh-What are you plotting!?
We Meganoids have but one goal.
To turn all humanity into Meganoids. You know that, Hazard Pasha?
From now on, line your pockets or flee to Earth, as you please.
Wh-Why, you...
Though Earth, too, will soon come under Don's rule...
Now then, farewell.
Damn that mere cyborg... No, wait, this won't do, this won't do at all!
With Annex dead, if the Meganoids cut ties with me now...
I'll have nothing but the forces on hand!
.........I know! If it's come to this, I'll drag those fools in too.
If it goes well, I may get a chance to turn the tables...
Heh heh heh, just you wait... you Federation lot! And you, Koros!
Anyone who makes a fool of me will live to regret it!
Hmph... For all the commotion, the Earth is still safe and sound.
How boring!
Butcher...
Eep! I-It's my god, Lord Gaizok!
Go... Butcher... The time of judgment... has come...
G-Go, you say... to slaughter those Earthlings?
Go... now... wicked... ones... of the... Land of Beginning...
A-As you will! Gaizok!
(Lately my god Gaizok's been acting strange... What's going on?)
Ugh... uhh...
So you're awake, Ilbora.
Ugh, where am I!?
The Terahertz.
What happened to me... Ngh, my body!?
During the battle with them, you boarded that machine, the Zerokage...
and it was I who found you drifting through space.
Zerokage...
Listen well, Ilbora... I am the one who saved you.
From now on, you'll do as I, your savior, command...
Heh... It seems things are moving in your favor...
or so I'd like to say, but don't get carried away, Hazard.
There's no one left behind you anymore... not even Annex.
The Emperor has already returned to planet Za Boom.
Fwahahaha! You don't know a thing, do you?
He only pretended to go back, and took refuge nearby...
What nonsense...
Planet Dirad... remember it? That asteroid like a lump of plants.
I clearly captured him being swallowed up in its explosion.
Shall I show you? Annex getting caught in the blast...
...Such confidence... It seems you're not lying.
...That's how it is. Be sure to keep this secret from Charm.
She seems the type to make a fuss.
Hazard, how is Ilbora doing?
Whoa, whoa there!
...Barging into a gentleman's room is not very becoming, Lady Charm.
You're awfully flustered, Hazard. Saying something I shouldn't hear?
N-N-Not at all!
...To think Lady Charm would worry about me.
Don't flatter yourself. You're the only one who can pilot the Zerokage.
I see. Unless I defeat Londo Bell with the Zerokage...
I won't be able to face Emperor Annex, is that it?
(Heh heh heh, that's it, Ilbora... If Charm learned Annex was dead,
there's no telling what she'd do...)
The Zerokage chose you... There's no way you can't do it, is there?
Well then, I have some business to attend to, so I'll take my leave...
Wait... Hazard. Where exactly are you going?
I am, after all, commander of the Mars base, so
I must show my face there as well...
Never mind him, Charm.
Our esteemed Mars colony base commander, like his character...
seems fond of that filthy Mars base.
Well... that's rather harsh. Anyway, I'll be going now. Ha ha ha.
(Grr! Just when I thought he'd turned meek! Remember this, Ilbora!)
Princess Romina, we have an incoming transmission...
How're you doing, Londo Bell folks?
...Who might this gentleman be?
This is Dr. Tarsan, who developed the Dangaioh.
How do you do, I am...
No need to say it. The princess of planet Radorio... Princess Romina, eh?
You know me well...
Well, naturally.
Vast as the universe is, there's hardly anything Tarsan doesn't know!
Then tell us what that mystery enemy is after.
Hm? Ah, that'd be... uh... wait, it's right on the tip of my tongue...
Who was it that knows everything, again?
...I said "hardly anything," didn't I?
Worst excuse ever.
...So, what can we do for you, Dr. Tarsan?
Right, I found out something about the Mars base,
so I thought I'd let you know.
About Mars...!? What did you find out!?
The current Mars colony base... it's the last war's Meganoid base,
simply remodeled and put to use, it seems.
Yeah, that's pretty well-known, isn't it?
The Mars base commander... er, who was it again?
Hazard... Hazard Pasha.
Right, that Hazard supplied power lines to the frozen Meganoids
and apparently woke them up.
Hmm. So it was as I suspected.
I had heard he was quite ambitious.
In his Titans days... for his extreme words and deeds, he was all but
exiled to the post of Mars colony base commander.
...I see. So he made the most of a bad situation.
That bastard's in with the Za Boom too... He's playing both sides!
But how did you find out about it, Dr. Tarsan?
...I've taken an interest in that robot called Tobikage.
In Tobikage!? Why?
That much potential in that size is astounding!
I'm a scientist too, after a fashion. I'd love to steal that technology!
...I can understand that feeling myself.
...So, anyway. There was a black robot,
like a counterpart to that robot Tobikage, right?
Ilbora's...!?
Didn't his comrades call it Zerokage or something?
That's the one. I caught it being carried
into the Meganoid base on Mars.
I see, the Za Boom and the Meganoids... So right now, two forces
are gathered on Mars.
Banjo...
If only I'd finished them off properly back then...
this never would have happened...!
Please don't blame yourself so... Master Banjo.
Yeah, Big Bro Banjo...
A concentration of forces... The Mars colony base will move soon.
I think so too. Now then...
We must not let them do that.
P-Princess Romina...?
...In that case, the enemy surely won't expect us to attack.
I believe we should warp the Elshank to the Mars base...
and strike first.
Whoa, whoa, what's gotten into you, Princess Romina?
Princess Romina proposing a plan...
I want to be of use to everyone too.
...Besides, I think Commander Hazuki or Captain Bright would decide so.
...Not much of a strategy... but that's where it ends up, I suppose.
If you copy what those old geezers do,
you'll run out of lives real fast, Princess Romina.
Still, ain't no better plan, is there?
Then again, it's business as usual.
All right, it's settled!
Well, I kinda had a feeling it'd turn out like this.
...This fight won't be settled before dinner, it seems,
Garrison.
Indeed, it seems we shall be packing a lunch.
Captain Burning, is this really all right...?
Uraki, you seem to have the wrong idea...
An all-out battle of concentrated forces will happen sooner or later.
...So it's to our advantage to strike before the enemy is ready.
Think about the bigger picture.
Looks to me like we're just charging in without a care.
Heh... What we need now is a charm called "a plan we can believe in."
...Princess Romina, Damian, have you located the Nadesico?
I've been at it this whole time... Minovsky particles, was it?
Geez, somebody invented a real nuisance.
Can't be helped... We'll have to search for the Nadesico as we fight.
I do hope Captain Misumaru is safe...
...I'll bet you anything that lady's alive and kicking.
Aw, then there ain't no bet to make...
Ah-CHOO!
Captain?
Maybe someone's talking about you?
Did you do something again, Yurika?
I didn't do anything. But it's fine! They say rumors only last forty-nine days!
Wrong meaning, and the wrong number of days.
